verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs cover all three pillars in one platform: banking (up to 20 checking accounts plus savings), spend management (debit and credit cards with spend limits, roles and real-time tracking, plus expense capture), and bill pay (bill upload, approvals and vendor payment), with invoicing that needs 'no separate tool.' Community reviews independently confirm the banking and card features. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of bill pay and spend-management depth, and explicit evidence that it fully replaces point tools (it still connects to apps like Expensify, and one user notes external payments are manual).

support.subject: As a founder, I can replace multiple point solutions for spend, bill pay, and banking with one consolidated platform

citations.quote: Open up to 20 checking accounts and auto-transfer every deposit
Issue Visa® debit³ or credit cards⁴, set spend limits, define roles, and track every transaction in real time.
Upload bills, delegate tasks, automate approvals, and pay vendors the way they want to be paid.
Build and send a branded invoice with built-in payment collection from Invoices — no separate tool needed.
